editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing your mattress is actually trying to eat you. That is exactly what happens to the main character in this wild ride of a movie. You get to follow a woman who finds herself trapped in her own bedroom, fighting a losing battle against a piece of furniture that has a mind of its own. The vibe is super tense and weird, making you feel like you can never truly trust your own home. It starts off slow, but once the bed starts pulling her in, the panic really kicks in and you will find yourself rooting for her to get out.

What really makes this work is the acting, as the lead does a great job of showing pure terror without saying much. The pacing is tight, though some might find the single location a bit much. If you like stories that make you feel trapped, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creepy details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick if you want something strange and scary.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the woman tries everything to cut herself free, but the bed pulls her down deeper into the mattress. The big twist is that the bed is not just a monster, but a loop that feeds on her fear. She eventually gets swallowed completely, leaving the room empty and quiet. It ends with a new person moving into the house, showing that the bed is just waiting for its next meal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and strange horror stories.
